title: Time Series Momentum (TSMOM) — Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen
signal_frequency: monthly rebalance; daily data for volatility estimation
data_requirements: daily futures excess returns with a documented roll convention
risk-free rate series to compute excess returns
wide cross-asset universe (equity indices, bonds, FX, commodities)
CFTC Commitments of Traders data (only for the speculator/hedger analysis)

sources.citation: Moskowitz, T. J., Ooi, Y. H., & Pedersen, L. H. (2012). Time series momentum. Journal of Financial Economics, 104(2), 228-250.
AQR Capital Management — Time Series Momentum: Original Paper Data (the paper's own monthly return series).
Huang, D., Li, J., Wang, L., & Zhou, G. Time-series momentum: Is it there? Journal of Financial Economics. (Primary challenge to the result.)
Lim, B., Zohren, S., & Roberts, S. (2019). Enhancing Time Series Momentum Strategies Using Deep Neural Networks.
